hero.title: Plan online. Sample in the field. Export without chaos.
hero.subtitle: TECHBYP - GPS Pro is a two-part soil sampling system: a website for planning, contracts, maps and exports, plus a mobile field app for recording every real sample with GPS and barcode support.
hero.proofA: Website workspace for contracts, fields, parameters and provider-ready exports.
hero.proofB: Android or iOS field app for actual sample recording during soil sampling.
hero.proofC: Barcode assignment, RTK support, external GPS devices, manual entries and automated recordings stay linked to the same project.

metrics.contractsLabel: one connected system instead of disconnected tools
metrics.fieldOpsLabel: for tracked samples, manual notes and operator workflows
metrics.exportsLabel: with export paths for AGROLAB, LUFA and PBS

features.title: Built for real soil sampling operations, not generic map demos.
features.subtitle: The system keeps planning, execution and handover in one place so the data still makes sense once the samples reach the lab.
features.mappingBody: Import or draw boundaries, keep field identities stable and prepare sampling cells without losing context.
features.contractsBody: Set up jobs, owners, laboratory profiles and provider-specific parameters before anyone drives to the field.
features.gpsBody: Support crews with map context, field focus and a workflow that works on desktop and tablet.
features.exportsBody: Prepare downstream files for AGROLAB, LUFA and PBS workflows without rebuilding project data by hand.

workflow.title: Four steps from planning to delivery.
workflow.subtitle: Each stage carries the same field and contract context forward, which means less manual repair later.
workflow.step1Body: Start with the customer, owner, lab workflow and sampling scope.
workflow.step2Body: Import boundaries or draw them directly and keep every field tied to the project.
workflow.step3Body: Guide fieldwork with GPS context, parameter choices and practical operator inputs.
workflow.step4Body: Generate structured outputs for lab handover, documentation and follow-up.

platforms.title: A website for coordination. A mobile app for actual sampling.
platforms.subtitle: Users can manage the project from the website, then switch to the Android or iOS field app when they are physically taking samples. Both parts work on the same project data.
platforms.fieldFeatureB: Manual sample entries while working in the field
platforms.fieldFeatureC: Automatic and GPS-backed recordings during collection
platforms.fieldFeatureD: RTK and external GPS devices can be linked for added accuracy

compatibility.title: Provider-aware output, not one-size-fits-all files.
compatibility.subtitle: Use one operational workflow, then export in the format the next step actually needs.

audiences.title: Useful for teams that move between office planning and field execution.
audiences.consultantsBody: Prepare contracts, field data and exports without splitting the job across multiple tools.
audiences.samplingBody: Work with clear GPS context, stable field references and less back-and-forth once the workday starts.
audiences.serviceBody: Keep project data consistent from first boundary upload to final provider-specific handover.

finalCta.title: One system across office planning and field sampling.
finalCta.subtitle: Use the website to manage contracts, maps and exports, then use the mobile app in the field to record the real sampling work with barcodes, RTK or external GPS devices, manual notes and automatic tracking.

privacy.title: Privacy notice for GPS soil sampling orders
privacy.subtitle: How contract, field, and sampling data is used in this order workflow.

sections.heading: 1. Scope of data used for the order
paragraphs: To prepare, execute, document, export, and invoice a soil sampling order, the application stores customer data, billing data, contract metadata, uploaded field boundaries, sampling parameters, field notes, barcode assignments, and export records.
This includes information entered manually by the user as well as files uploaded for the order, such as shapefiles, XML files, and generated laboratory exports.

sections.heading: 2. Purpose of processing
bullets: creating and managing the order draft and final contract
displaying and editing field boundaries and field metadata
preparing field sampling work for office and field staff
generating laboratory-specific export files and project workbooks
tracking status, barcodes, and completion history for the order

sections.heading: 3. Storage and access
paragraphs: Order data is stored in the TECHBYP GPS platform and is accessible to authorized users according to their role and project assignment. Access may include administrators, office staff, samplers, and other users required to complete the contract.
Uploaded files and generated export files may contain personal and business-related information and are therefore treated as order records.

sections.heading: 4. Laboratory transfer
paragraphs: When a laboratory export is created, the data selected for that export is transferred to the chosen laboratory workflow in the required file format. Depending on the provider and profile, this may include customer references, field identifiers, land use, crop-related metadata, barcodes, and sampling information.

sections.heading: 5. Retention and correction
paragraphs: Order records should only be retained for as long as they are operationally or legally required. Incorrect customer, billing, or field information should be corrected before submission or export whenever possible.
If legal retention duties apply, deletion or anonymization should follow the responsible organization's retention policy.

privacy.footer: This modal provides order-specific notice text for the GPS soil sampling workflow. It should still be reviewed against your final legal wording and jurisdiction-specific requirements.

processing.title: Consent to process order data
processing.subtitle: Permission to use the entered data for execution of the requested laboratory and sampling services.

sections.heading: 1. Processing basis for this contract
paragraphs: By confirming this item, the customer agrees that the data entered for the order may be processed to plan, perform, document, and complete the requested soil sampling and laboratory workflow.

sections.heading: 2. Data involved
bullets: sampling parameters, service selections, and field-level notes
barcodes, bag identifiers, and export references
laboratory-specific order data required for export files

sections.heading: 3. Operational recipients
paragraphs: The data may be processed by the platform operator and by persons involved in fulfilling the order, including administrative staff, field personnel, and the chosen laboratory or its technical import workflow where required for contract performance.

sections.heading: 4. Limitation
paragraphs: Processing is limited to what is necessary to fulfill the order, maintain documentation, and produce the requested exports and reports.

processing.footer: This confirmation should be backed by your final contract wording and, where needed, a separate data processing agreement or customer notice.

digital.title: Consent to digital documents only
digital.subtitle: No paper copies are required for this order unless separately agreed.

sections.heading: 1. Digital communication
paragraphs: By confirming this item, the customer agrees that order-related documents may be created, stored, and provided in digital form only. This may include confirmations, export files, sampling records, reports, and invoices where legally permissible.

sections.heading: 2. Delivery channels
bullets: email recipients stored with the order

sections.heading: 3. No automatic paper delivery
paragraphs: If this option is accepted, paper delivery is not expected as the default. Printed copies must be requested separately if the workflow or law requires them.

digital.footer: Confirming digital-only delivery does not override mandatory statutory paper requirements in jurisdictions where they still apply.

terms.title: Order terms and conditions (AGB)
terms.subtitle: Core contract terms for the GPS soil sampling order workflow.

sections.heading: 1. Contract subject
paragraphs: The order covers the services selected in the wizard, including planning, field preparation, sampling support, documentation, and laboratory export preparation as applicable to the selected provider and profile.

sections.heading: 2. Customer obligations
bullets: provide correct customer and billing data
provide correct field boundaries or uploaded source files
review service selection, land use, and field metadata before submission
ensure that uploaded files and references may lawfully be used for the order

sections.heading: 3. Export and laboratory interfaces
paragraphs: The platform generates laboratory export files based on the data entered and selected by the user. The customer is responsible for verifying provider-specific information before the file is transmitted or used operationally.

sections.heading: 4. Liability and verification
paragraphs: Generated files, maps, and summaries should be checked before operational use. The workflow is intended to support order handling, but incorrect input data can still result in incorrect exports or reports.

sections.heading: 5. Billing and documentation
paragraphs: Billing, reporting, and supporting documentation are based on the saved order data and the selected workflow configuration. Additional provider-specific charges or external laboratory charges may apply outside the platform.

terms.footer: This is order-specific placeholder AGB content for the soil sampling workflow and should be replaced or approved by the final legal owner before production use.

privacy.section1Intro: TECHBYP AI collects and processes the following types of information:
privacy.section1Item1: Account Information: Username, email address, role, and avatar image
privacy.section1Item2: Usage Data: Chat conversations, file uploads, workflow data, and product information
privacy.section1Item3: Technical Data: IP addresses, browser type, device information, and access logs
privacy.section1Item4: Inventory Data: Product details, stock levels, storage locations, and QR code scans
privacy.section2Item1: Providing and maintaining the TECHBYP AI service
privacy.section2Item2: Processing AI chat requests and providing intelligent assistance
privacy.section2Item3: Managing inventory, workflows, and project tracking

privacy.section2Item5: Improving system performance and user experience
privacy.section3Intro: Your data is stored securely on our servers with the following protections:
privacy.section3Item3: Role-based access control (RBAC) to limit data access
privacy.section3Item5: Secure file storage with access logging
privacy.section4Intro: TECHBYP AI uses local AI models (Ollama) for processing your requests:
privacy.section4Item1: Chat conversations are processed locally and stored in your chat history
privacy.section4Item2: No data is sent to external AI services without your explicit consent
privacy.section4Item3: Memory files you upload are used to provide context to the AI assistant
privacy.section4Item4: You can delete your chat history and memory files at any time
privacy.section5Intro: We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties. Data is only accessible to:
privacy.section5Item1: Authorized users within your organization based on role permissions
privacy.section5Item2: System administrators for maintenance and support purposes
privacy.section5Item3: Legal authorities when required by law
privacy.section6Item1: Access your personal data at any time
privacy.section6Item2: Update or correct your account information
privacy.section6Item3: Delete your account and associated data

privacy.section7Text: We retain your data for as long as your account is active. Upon account deletion, personal data is removed within 30 days. System logs and audit trails may be retained for up to 1 year for security and compliance purposes.
privacy.section8Text: TECHBYP AI uses local storage to maintain your session and preferences. We do not use third-party tracking cookies or analytics services that collect personal information.
privacy.section9Text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Users will be notified of significant changes through the application or via email. Continued use of TECHBYP AI after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy.section10Text: For questions about this Privacy Policy or data protection concerns, please contact your system administrator or reach out to MoonRaven support.

dataProtectionContent.section1Text: At TECHBYP AI, we take data protection seriously. This document outlines our technical and organizational measures to ensure the security, integrity, and confidentiality of your data in compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and other applicable data protection regulations.
dataProtectionContent.section2_1Item1: Encryption: All data transmission uses TLS 1.3 encryption (HTTPS)
dataProtectionContent.section2_1Item2: Password Protection: Passwords are hashed using bcrypt with salt
dataProtectionContent.section2_1Item3: Authentication: JWT-based authentication with secure token storage
dataProtectionContent.section2_1Item4: Session Management: Automatic session expiration and token refresh
dataProtectionContent.section2_1Item5: Database Security: Encrypted database connections and secure backups
dataProtectionContent.section2_1Item6: File Storage: Secure file system with access control lists (ACL)
dataProtectionContent.section2_2Item1: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Granular permissions based on user roles
dataProtectionContent.section2_2Item2: Least Privilege Principle: Users only access data necessary for their role
dataProtectionContent.section2_2Item3: Multi-Factor Authentication: Optional 2FA for enhanced security
dataProtectionContent.section2_2Item4: Account Monitoring: Login attempt tracking and suspicious activity alerts
dataProtectionContent.section2_2Item5: IP Whitelisting: Optional restriction of access to specific IP ranges
dataProtectionContent.section2_3Item1: Regular security patches and system updates
dataProtectionContent.section2_3Item2: Firewall protection and intrusion detection systems
dataProtectionContent.section2_3Item3: Regular security audits and penetration testing
dataProtectionContent.section2_3Item4: Isolated development, staging, and production environments
dataProtectionContent.section2_3Item5: Secure backup procedures with encrypted storage
dataProtectionContent.section3_1Intro: TECHBYP AI uses locally-hosted AI models (Ollama) to ensure data privacy:
dataProtectionContent.section3_1Item1: No data is sent to external AI services (OpenAI, Google, etc.)
dataProtectionContent.section3_1Item2: All AI processing occurs on your own infrastructure
dataProtectionContent.section3_1Item3: Chat history remains within your organization
dataProtectionContent.section3_1Item4: You have full control over AI model selection and configuration
dataProtectionContent.section3_2Intro: All data is stored on your designated servers:
dataProtectionContent.section3_2Item1: No cloud storage unless explicitly configured by you
dataProtectionContent.section3_2Item2: Data residency in your chosen geographic location
dataProtectionContent.section3_2Item3: Full control over data location and jurisdiction
dataProtectionContent.section3_2Item4: No cross-border data transfers without your consent
dataProtectionContent.section4PersonalItem3: Retention: Duration of account existence + 30 days
dataProtectionContent.section4OperationalItem1: Product inventory, workflow data, file uploads
dataProtectionContent.section4OperationalItem2: Purpose: Service functionality and business operations
dataProtectionContent.section4OperationalItem3: Retention: As long as actively used or required by business needs
dataProtectionContent.section4UsageItem2: Purpose: Security monitoring and system optimization
dataProtectionContent.section5Intro: Under GDPR and similar regulations, you have the right to:
dataProtectionContent.section5Item1: Right to Access: Request a copy of all personal data we hold about you
dataProtectionContent.section5Item2: Right to Rectification: Correct inaccurate or incomplete data
dataProtectionContent.section5Item3: Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your personal data ("right to be forgotten")
dataProtectionContent.section5Item4: Right to Restriction: Limit how we process your data
dataProtectionContent.section5Item5: Right to Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
dataProtectionContent.section5Item6: Right to Object: Object to certain types of data processing
dataProtectionContent.section5Item7: Right to Withdraw Consent: Withdraw previously given consent at any time
dataProtectionContent.section6Intro: In the event of a data breach, we will:
dataProtectionContent.section6Item1: Contain and investigate the breach within 24 hours
dataProtectionContent.section6Item3: Report to relevant data protection authorities as required
dataProtectionContent.section6Item4: Document the incident and implement preventive measures
dataProtectionContent.section6Item5: Provide detailed information about affected data and mitigation steps
dataProtectionContent.section7Text: TECHBYP AI minimizes third-party dependencies. We do not share your data with external services unless:
dataProtectionContent.section7Item1: You explicitly configure integration with external tools
dataProtectionContent.section7Item2: Required by law (e.g., law enforcement requests)
dataProtectionContent.section7Item3: Necessary for service provision (e.g., infrastructure hosting)
dataProtectionContent.section7Text2: Any third-party processors are contractually bound to maintain the same level of data protection.
dataProtectionContent.section8Text: For organizations processing significant amounts of personal data, we recommend designating a Data Protection Officer (DPO). Contact your system administrator for DPO information or to exercise your data rights.
dataProtectionContent.section9Text: If your organization operates internationally, data transfers are conducted in compliance with:
dataProtectionContent.section9Item3: Appropriate safeguards as required by GDPR
dataProtectionContent.section10Text: TECHBYP AI is designed for business use and is not intended for children under 16 years of age. We do not knowingly collect data from children. If you believe a child has provided personal information, please contact us immediately for removal.
dataProtectionContent.section11Intro: TECHBYP AI is designed to comply with:
dataProtectionContent.section12Text: We review and update this Data Protection policy regularly to ensure compliance with evolving regulations. Users will be notified of significant changes. The "Last updated" date at the top indicates the most recent revision.
dataProtectionContent.section13Intro: To exercise your data rights or for data protection inquiries, please contact:
dataProtectionContent.section13Text: We will respond to all legitimate requests within 30 days as required by GDPR.
